name: The companion as an equal partner
body: Dean's play-test (2026-11-16): the player and the companion are equals and a team, not a commander and a follower. Replace the Q/E/F command model with a companion who leads or works beside the player, make her robust on every level (no walking off edges, no getting stuck, never left behind), and make a level count only when she finishes it with the player. Rework the prototype rooms and the crossing to fit.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's play-test of the prototype rooms and the crossing (#107, #108).

plan: 1. Team beats and the partner state machine. 2. Edge, stuck and fall safety. 3. Finish together. 4. Rework the rooms and the crossing. 5. Docs, decisions, checklist.
acceptance_criteria: She can follow every prototype room and the crossing
A level completes only with her beside the player
